'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Garrett Larson LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3). Typed list; sheet name Garrett. Heavy Naboo Defense Fighter package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
